name: Jehoahaz
bio: Jehoahaz, son of Josiah, was anointed king of Judah by the people of the land after his father's death at Megiddo, at twenty-three years old; his mother was Hamutal, daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah. He reigned only three months in Jerusalem, doing evil in the LORD's eyes like his ancestors. Pharaoh-Necho of Egypt imprisoned him at Riblah, prevented him from reigning, and imposed tribute on Judah, taking Jehoahaz to Egypt, where he died (2 Kings 23:30-34).
